information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM0MTQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7f34914b5332590a45179b151b57aff31bc93690/Logo%20Sendero%20Tijuana%202025%20(1).png) **¡Bienvenidos a “Sendero Tijuana 2025”!** Nos alegra presentar la **tercera competencia oficial totalmente gratuita en la ciudad de Tijuana**, reafirmando el compromiso de seguir acercando el speedcubing a más jóvenes y familias en Baja California. Este evento busca fomentar un ambiente de sana competitividad y aprendizaje, ofreciendo a los nuevos competidores la oportunidad perfecta para vivir su primera experiencia en una competencia avalada por la WCA. *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)antes de la competencia.* **Welcome to “Sendero Tijuana 2025”!** We are proud to present the **third official competition completely free of charge in the city of Tijuana**, continuing our commitment to bringing speedcubing closer to more youth and families in Baja California. This event aims to foster an environment of healthy competition and learning, offering new competitors the perfect opportunity to experience their very first WCA official competition. *This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.*
